notes: Validated against Kim PB et al. Nature 2015. ZTP/ZMP riboswitch from Fusobacterium ulcerans. Ligand AMZ (ZMP = AICAR monophosphate, 5-aminoimidazole-4-carboxamide ribonucleotide, MW=338) at A:101. 13 MG ions and 4 IRI (iridium hexamine crystallization agents) removed. Companion to 6WZS (ZTP, 3 phosphates) — tests whether monophosphate alone drives enrichment.
